title: What It Really Costs to Own a Corvette Z06
description:
The Chevrolet Corvette Z06 is often called a supercar for the price of a sports car. Six hundred seventy horsepower, a hand-built engine, and a starting price around one hundred twenty thousand dollars. But what does it really cost to own one? Not just to buy it, but to insure it, fuel it, maintain it, and eventually sell it? The answer has a twist. For some early buyers, the most expensive part of owning a Z06 was not fuel or tires. It was a decision they made at the dealership, before they ever drove the car. We will show you exactly what happened, with real auction results.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.
